payload.description:
**Blocked by:** nothing. Start here.

CfnBudget in CDK with an SNS topic to the owner. This is a permanent control, not scaffolding: it is the only thing that catches a bug in our own code, which no authentication check ever will.

**Done when:** a budget exists in CDK, a test notification arrives, and the OpenAI project hard cap is set in the OpenAI console by a human.
payload.title: Alarm on AWS spend before anything else changes
